title: Facebook Symbols — Copy & Paste Reactions, Hearts & Emoji
meta_description: Copy and paste Facebook symbols — reaction emoji, hearts, stars, and dividers for posts, comments, bios, and Page names. Click any symbol to copy it instantly.
hero_tagline: Copy and paste reaction emoji, hearts, stars, and dividers for Facebook posts, comments, bios, and Page names. Click any symbol to copy it instantly.
intro: Facebook accepts standard Unicode text almost everywhere — posts, comments, the About/bio section, Page and Group descriptions, and Messenger. This library collects the symbols people paste there most: text equivalents of Facebook's own Like, Love, and Haha reactions, hearts and stars for a bio or About line, bullets and dividers for structuring a longer post, checkmarks for lists and announcements, and frame characters for Page and Group names. The one exception is the personal profile Name field, which is checked against Facebook's real-name policy and strips most decoration — see the FAQ for what still works there.
notes: OPP: 7th instance of the proven platform-symbol-library template (instagram-symbols, whatsapp-symbols, discord-symbols, tiktok-symbols, linkedin-symbol-library, x-twitter-symbols). Demand source: competitor gap analysis — piliapp's /facebook-symbols/ page carries 10,589 FR traffic, top keyword “emoji facebook,” 127 ranking keywords, no existing EN or FR equivalent anywhere on the site. English-first per the backlog; localize once translation pipeline reaches this page. The shipped library/facebook-symbols/index.html is hand-finished beyond this spec (hero image, FAQPage JSON-LD, alternateName) to match the current template standard set by discord-symbols/tiktok-symbols; this spec captures the section/symbol content for provenance and possible regeneration.
